title: hotfix: fix connection leak and hysteresis ordering in SLO enforcer during regional failover
author: Priya Shah
description: Summary: Urgent hotfix to address two issues observed during a regional failover exercise and an incident on 2026-02-19: (1) a connection leak in the SLO enforcer's transport layer that caused gradual resource exhaustion on long-lived failover paths; (2) incorrect ordering of backoff/hysteresis updates in the SLO enforcer that allowed rapid oscillation (thrashing) when queues transitioned between local and regional modes. Motivation: customer-facing outages and internal canary failures during failover testing (ENG-4821, ENG-4822). This PR applies a minimal, well-tested fix that unblocks Dedicated and Private customers while preserving existing behavior for steady-state traffic. Checklist: - [x] Reproduce locally with failover e2e harness and unit tests - [x] Fix connection leak in connection_pool and add pool telemetry - [x] Ensure backoff/hysteresis state updates are applied atomically and ordered to prevent thrash - [x] Add new unit + integration tests covering failover ordering and connection retention - [x] CI green (unit + e2e) - [x] Post-merge monitoring dashboard and alert added (short retention) Changes: - Fixes connection leak by ensuring returned connections are always closed/returned on error paths in pkg/transport/connection_pool.go - Adds explicit pool metrics (leaked_conn_count, pool_wait_ms) and exposes them to the SLO console - Reorders the SLO enforcer update path to apply hysteresis/backoff transitions under the same state lock and adds a short jitter to avoid synchronized client retries - Adds integration test harness scenario failover/regression/fix-362345 that simulates regional handoff and verifies no thrashing and bounded concurrent connections Rollout: Squash-merged to main with a short-lived canary followed by a full rollout to Dedicated pools. Monitoring dashboards and an alert (SLO-Enforcer:High-LeakedConns) were added and will be watched for 48 hours. Notes: This is a hotfix; changes are intentionally focused and conservative. We may follow up with a performance-oriented refactor after stabilization.
commits: a1b3f2c: fix(connection_pool): close connections on error return paths and add pool metrics
b2c4d6e: fix(slo-enforcer): apply hysteresis/backoff updates under lock and add jitter to transition timing
c3d5e7f: test(failover): add e2e scenario that reproduces ordering thrash and verifies max concurrent connections
review_thread: Marcus Lee (reviewer): Found a race when state transitions happen during metric flushing - requested atomic update and added tests.
Priya Shah (author): Addressed with lock around update path and added a targeted unit test that reproduces the race.
Ana Rodriguez (reviewer): Asked to avoid introducing long-held locks on hot path; suggested micro-benchmark. Author added minimal scoped lock and micro-bench showed negligible p99 impact.
Chen Wang (reviewer): Verified telemetry and suggested alert thresholds. Elena approved after smoke-testing against canary deployment. CI rerun after adding tests passed.
release_notes: Hotfix: Fix connection leak in SLO enforcer transport and stabilize hysteresis/backoff ordering during regional failover. Adds pool telemetry and short-term alerting. Backwards-compatible; no consumer changes required.
postmerge_actions: Observe canary latency/cost for 2 hours before full rollout
Follow-up ticket to refactor pool implementation for perf (ENG-4900)
